title: Leonardo da Vinci: Renaissance Master
description: The ultimate Renaissance genius - artist, inventor, scientist, and visionary who painted the Mona Lisa
imageHint: 🎨 The ultimate Renaissance man of art and invention 📐

questions.question: What is Leonardo's most famous painting, known for its subject's mysterious smile?
questions.hint: It's of a woman with an enigmatic smile, housed in the Louvre

questions.question: Leonardo's fresco depicting Christ's final meal with his disciples is called what?
questions.hint: It shows Jesus announcing that one of his disciples will betray him

questions.question: Leonardo wrote his notes in what unusual manner that required a mirror to read easily?
questions.hint: You need a mirror to read it normally - written from right to left

questions.question: What flying machine design did Leonardo create centuries before actual flight was achieved?
questions.hint: A machine with flapping wings like a bird, from Greek words for 'bird' and 'wing'

questions.question: Leonardo's detailed anatomical drawings were based on his illegal practice of what?
questions.hint: Cutting open dead bodies to study internal structure - forbidden by the church

deeperMode.title: The Obsessive Perfectionist
deeperMode.description: Leonardo's relentless pursuit of knowledge and his unfinished masterpieces

questions.question: Leonardo was notorious for leaving works unfinished. Approximately how many paintings did he complete in his lifetime?
questions.hint: Fewer than twenty - his perfectionism often prevented him from finishing

questions.question: What did Leonardo call the phenomenon where distant objects appear blue or hazy?
questions.hint: A technique that shows depth by making distant objects appear less distinct and bluer
